member.name: T:Arcfrag.Core.Contract.IPlatformEvents
member.summary: The capability future mode plugins (Deathmatch, Retake, Training, Party, Duels) use to reach the platform.

remarks.para: This is deliberately the only supported integration point. Implementations own the backend URL, HTTP transport, authentication and retry policy, so a mode plugin never handles credentials or builds its own client.
Retrieve it through SwiftlyS2's shared interfaces (IInterfaceManager), under the key :
All members are safe to call from the CS2 game thread: they capture data and return immediately without performing network I/O inline.

member.summary: Queues a platform event for delivery with PlatformCore's retry policy.

remarks.para: V1 accepts player_connected and player_disconnected (which PlatformCore already emits itself) and match_completed, the one event a mode plugin sends: pass , a null SteamId64 and a payload once a match has ended. PlatformCore validates it with , requires its mode to be , wraps it in a version 1 envelope with a new event ID and queues it; retries repeat that event ID.
Unknown event types and invalid matches are rejected and logged rather than sent.

member.returns: true when the event was accepted into the queue.

member.summary: Reports one kill between two humans in a per-kill Elo mode (Deathmatch variants). PlatformCore adds it to the match's next kill_batch (sent every 10 seconds and before the match's match_completed), computes the provisional Elo change from its cache with the same rules as the API, shows the kill feedback and returns it. Bots, suicides and world deaths are never reported. Safe on the game thread; no network I/O inline.
member.param: The mode plugin's match; a new ID starts a new batch sequence.

member.returns: The provisional rating, or null when the kill was refused (not a per-kill mode, invalid, PlatformCore disabled).
